g.title: logic
g.text: R1 logic: one English instruction, and the protection below it (2026-09-30)

g.title: cluster_ask
g.text: r1_mission_cli.py ask "<English>" (one process; nothing moves before the operator's y)

g.title: cluster_below
g.text: Always on, below the mission layer (r1_hw_bridge, C++)

g.title: s0
g.text: (each ask stands alone: no memory of the last one)

g.title: n1
g.text: number words -> digits; feet, minutes, km/h -> m, s, m/s
unless the sentence is vague; "N times: ..." written out

g.title: y1
g.text: print the parsed plan (vx, wz, seconds, degrees)

g.title: m1
g.text: writes the steps down in a JSON schema of 10 step shapes,
it is NOT told the robot's limits

g.title: p1
g.text: provenance: every distance, duration and angle must be in
the normalized text with its unit; anything else is dropped

g.title: t1
g.text: backward, sideways, unsupported, no amount, too fast, too small
-> refusal with a reason; a step under 2 s is slowed

g.title: e2
g.text: ("I can turn around and walk forward");

g.title: r1
g.text: Executor, 10 Hz, one primitive at a time -> ~/cmd_vel
walk: time at the commanded speed, 0.5 s ramps
turn: on the spot, closed on IMU yaw, tapered; timeout 2x its estimate

g.title: e1
g.text: zero cmd_vel at once; reply says what ran,
what did not, and why ("Stopped early: ...")

g.title: d1
g.text: hold zero for the settle time

g.title: ok
g.text: template reply: "Walked forward for 2.0 s at 0.20 m/s: about 0.4 m
(time x commanded speed; not measured)", "Turned left 90.2° by my IMU"

g.title: g1
g.text: no message for 500 ms -> command zero
